name: The Viper's Jaw
desc:
The Viper's Jaw is the general name of the [Lower Erisia](location:lower_erisia) cave system.

It is divided into three parts. One entrance is behind the bandit village, where two guaranteed Megalodaunt spawns are located; the second entrance is on the side of the bandit village. An opening leads to Upper Erisia's broken bridge. A library plays an important role in intelligence unbound. A Legion camp is also settled here, which allows for the player to learn both Legion Kata by giving a Legion Captain’s Recommendation to [Amara](entity:amara), and Imperium Kata by completing [Caitus](entity:caitus)' quest of giving the Legion Intelligence to [Titus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus) and then coming back to him.

Note that none of these areas are directly connected to each other.
